descriptionChirho: Active transitive sense: to prepare, make ready, or furnish something (a meal, a place, materials) for a specific purpose or person.

labelChirho: be prepared, having been made ready
descriptionChirho: Passive and stative sense: to have been prepared or made ready, describing a state of readiness resulting from prior preparation.
Middle/reflexive sense: to prepare oneself or get oneself ready, used intransitively of people making themselves ready for action or an event.
